decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The deck includes a mix of low-cost creatures, burn spells, and card draw to maintain pressure on the opponent and control the battlefield. By utilizing a combination of card advantage and direct damage, the deck aims to finish off the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize or mount a strong defense. The key strategy is to maintain tempo and pressure throughout the game to secure victory.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to control the board early with cheap removal spells like Abrade and Torch the Tower, while deploying aggressive creatures like Marauding Mako and Vivi Ornitier to deal quick damage to the opponent. The deck also aims to outvalue the opponent with powerful spells like Prof's Eidetic Memory and Winternight Stories, all while maintaining card advantage and tempo. The inclusion of cards like Fear of Missing Out and Soulstone Sanctuary helps to keep the pressure on the opponent and close out the game quickly.
